missions.name: The 701st File
missions.premise: A Blue Book residual acquires meaning only when a Lattice coordinate frame is recovered. The file is authentic; the future coordinate interpretation is F.
missions.objective: Secure the archive bridge without destroying either the original scan or the later annotation layer.

missions.name: Arnold Lexicon
missions.premise: Three factions build different craft profiles from one witness description because later illustrations became more influential than the original words.
missions.objective: Classify targets by behavior rather than inherited silhouette labels.

missions.name: The Mantell Rule
missions.premise: A pursuit doctrine memorializes the danger of chasing an unknown beyond sensor and vehicle limits.
missions.objective: Win while refusing a lure that offers combat advantage outside verified coverage.

missions.name: Jafari Chain
missions.premise: Records modeled on the 1976 Tehran case disagree across witness, aircraft, weapon, and command channels.
missions.objective: Keep each evidence stream intact while an Archonic spoof tries to merge them into one false certainty.

missions.name: Nimitz Partition
missions.premise: Eyewitness, radar, infrared, and later recollection are stored as separate objects rather than one perfect account.
missions.objective: Reconstruct the route without granting any single sensor total authority.

missions.name: GoFast Geometry
missions.premise: A strange-looking track becomes conventional after geometry is modeled, while exact identity remains unknown.
missions.objective: Score higher by resolving behavior without inventing an identity.

missions.name: Aguadilla Split
missions.premise: Apparent splitting and ocean entry compete with a conventional two-object and sensor-geometry analysis.
missions.objective: Prevent both a Compact false-USO narrative and a Human claim that all ocean anomalies are solved.

missions.name: Record Group 615
missions.premise: FAA, NRC, ODNI, OSD, NSA, State, and FBI transfers arrive with incompatible metadata and release conditions.
missions.objective: Create a searchable common schema without deleting agency provenance.

missions.name: The Greenewald Standard
missions.premise: A Pirate archive offers millions of pages but demands that denial letters, appeals, and missing attachments remain tradeable assets.
missions.objective: Publish enough to preserve trust without surrendering vulnerable sources.

missions.name: Space Tiger Team
missions.premise: A 2023 space/transmedium detection framework becomes the ancestor of orbital anomaly deconfliction.
missions.objective: Identify duplicate tracks across domains without treating the word transmedium as a conclusion.

missions.name: Seventy-Eight Frames
missions.premise: A Navy denial confirms responsive classified UAP photographs existed but not what they depict.
missions.objective: Preserve the existence of the records after the image content is deleted by a hostile archive process.

missions.name: The Virginia Hundred
missions.premise: A Navy report describes roughly one hundred airborne observations and two likely uncrewed surface systems; the future operator remains unknown.
missions.objective: Protect civilian traffic while three factions weaponize the object count as propaganda.

missions.name: Satellite Flare Flood
missions.premise: A new modeling capability resolves large numbers of reports as satellite reflections.
missions.objective: Calm a population without allowing the Compact to hide one unrelated operation inside the mass resolution.

missions.name: Diamond in SWIR
missions.premise: A 2024 report describes a diamond-shaped object detectable in short-wave infrared; the public clip is descriptive, not a final analytic judgment.
missions.objective: Build a sensor chain that can test detection-band dependence.

missions.name: Surface Turns
missions.premise: A 2023 maritime clip is reported as showing turns near the ocean surface, but sensor motion and range remain contested.
missions.objective: Retrieve native data before a Pirate copy becomes the only surviving record.

missions.name: Malmstrom Alert, 1975
missions.premise: Historical records describe unknown craft reports around sensitive installations and attempted interception.
missions.objective: Hold the weapons site without mistaking uncertainty for permission to launch.

missions.name: Echo Flight, 1967
missions.premise: Missile-disablement claims, later testimony, missing documentation, and conventional explanations coexist.
missions.objective: Maintain two live interpretations while a faction tries to canonize one for political gain.

missions.name: JAL 1628
missions.premise: A long-duration aviation report becomes a test of crew testimony, radar context, and public release.
missions.objective: Escort the flight and preserve independent logs through a communications blackout.

missions.name: O Hare Aperture
missions.premise: An airport sighting and cloud-hole narrative become a mass-belief event with limited official data.
missions.objective: Prevent panic and memory convergence from turning uncertain witness accounts into one manufactured revelation.

missions.name: Socorro Traces
missions.premise: A close-range report includes alleged ground traces and a vehicle-like object.
missions.objective: Distinguish physical trace, witness interpretation, and later symbol reconstruction.

missions.name: Levelland Circuit
missions.premise: Vehicle-electrical effects reported across a region compete with weather and ignition explanations.
missions.objective: Keep the grid running while testing whether the effect follows environment, machines, or narrative contagion.

missions.name: Majestic Custody
missions.premise: A document can be archived and investigated without being authentic.
missions.objective: Expose the forgery while finding the real compartmentation practice it copied.

missions.name: Project Beta
missions.premise: A sincere witness, classified testing, alleged disinformation, and underground-base mythology contaminate one another.
missions.objective: Rescue the person and the evidence without validating the false total story.

missions.name: Active Archive
missions.premise: Cases with too little data are retained rather than solved or discarded.
missions.objective: Design an archive policy that allows future learning without turning uncertainty into permanent suspicion.

missions.name: Five Releases
missions.premise: Five government release batches become searchable through processed OCR, transcripts, media, and metadata, but the derivative corpus cannot replace the originals.
missions.objective: Reconcile 375 records without erasing release batch, source hash, processing history, or OCR uncertainty.

missions.name: Parallel Track
missions.premise: A business jet reports an object pacing it over Nevada while witness language changes and the most useful radar files remain unavailable.
missions.objective: Protect the flight and preserve black-program, foreign-platform, conventional, and exotic hypotheses until the evidence can separate them.

missions.name: Media Integrity Ladder
missions.premise: Native sensor products, screen recordings, altered copies, witness videos, and artistic recreations are mixed into one apparent evidence feed.
missions.objective: Restore parent-child provenance and prevent a reconstruction from being scored as event footage.

missions.name: Null Search Appeal
missions.premise: An agency refuses to search for a phrase because the alleged program is said not to exist, even though records may discuss the allegation itself.
missions.objective: Compel a lawful search without converting the appeal victory into proof that the alleged program was real.

missions.name: Evaluation 585
missions.premise: An inspector-general proposal reveals what the institution intended to evaluate while the claimed benefits and capability details remain redacted.
missions.objective: Map the detection and counterintelligence workflow without treating classification as an extraordinary finding.

missions.name: Diplomatic Sky
missions.premise: State Department records preserve UAP-related reports as diplomatic, cultural, and political events across several countries, not only as sensor cases.
missions.objective: Translate and compare reports without stripping away local context or turning diplomatic transmission into endorsement.

missions.name: Contactee Network
missions.premise: FBI files on contactees, organizations, investigators, broadcasters, skeptics, and disputed documents record how belief networks spread and were monitored.
missions.objective: Separate correspondence, surveillance, fraud inquiry, sincere belief, and later mythology before reconstructing the network.

missions.name: Proposal Not Program
missions.premise: A dramatic special-access proposal is repeatedly cited as an operational recovery program even though it was never approved, funded, established, or supplied with material.
missions.objective: Recover the proposal history while stopping every faction from skipping the proposal-program-operation ladder.

missions.name: Ordinary Alloy
missions.premise: A specimen with an extraordinary recovery story is tested and found consistent with ordinary industrial alloy.
missions.objective: Preserve chain of custody, analytical method, and negative result while searching separately for the origin of the story.

missions.name: Refuse to Answer
missions.premise: A mandatory reporting system converted every blank field into a confident negative, manufacturing a false pattern across thousands of reports.
missions.objective: Reconstruct the original uncertainty states and redesign the form without destroying useful structured data.

missions.name: Watcher Array
missions.premise: An event-based sensor mesh detects every moving cluster but initially labels each one unidentified, including drones, reflections, fauna, and one persistent residual.
missions.objective: Maintain custody and characterize signatures before any faction turns a provisional track into a declared enemy.

missions.name: The Soda Can
missions.premise: A classified image becomes conspiracy evidence even though the protected information concerns the collecting platform, metadata, and sensor performance rather than the ordinary object in frame.
missions.objective: Declassify enough to resolve the subject while preventing the release from exposing how to evade the sensor.

missions.name: Native Master
missions.premise: Six viral edits and three official derivatives descend from one native recording whose first hash and metadata log are missing.
missions.objective: Recover the memory card, establish the earliest defensible master, and preserve every fork without promoting any edit into original evidence.
